title: Desktop & reading
caption: The accepted spatial direction, with the current compact, cleaner workbench treatment. Preserves W1.
notes: Active Workspace, collapsed exploration, unchecked reference nodes, edge creation controls and navigation dock coexist. Grouping, proximity and collapse never change input inclusion.

Reference nodes expose attachment checkboxes and output pins. Their attachment scope is still open; unchecked and unwired examples leave the illustrated run unchanged. The inspector still reads the selected Context at any zoom.
Square Contexts, rounded-rectangle Processes, unboxed idle persona/tone controls and colored square pins follow the latest visual feedback.

title: Semantic zoom / two Workspace views
caption: Two separate fixed windows show the same connected cluster at 65% and 100% camera zoom.
notes: All nodes, pin anchors, wires and gaps use the same camera transform; no node is resized independently. The world positions, selected versions and attachment states are unchanged.
Context text is 13 px in both views. At the closer zoom, M4 has more screen space and reveals more of the same retained text. This is presentation, not a new summary or run.
The outer windows and chrome are identical. More of the surroundings fit at 65%; the 100% camera crops peripheral nodes. Exact zoom thresholds remain Draft.

title: Source-pin creation palette
caption: Choose Respond after dragging U1’s output into empty space.
notes: The palette appears at the drop location. Choosing Respond creates only the Process and its input connection.
No output destination and no inference are silently created.
Respond, Continue, Explode and Challenge use the working vocabulary; the final MVP set remains open.

title: Process without output
caption: Run is unavailable because Respond still needs a destination.
notes: The nearby explanation makes the disabled state actionable.
Run belongs to the Process, not the Context.
None is selected for the example; new-Process defaults are still unresolved.

title: Destination creation palette
caption: A separate drag from Respond’s output creates Model Context.
notes: This explicitly separates choosing an action from choosing its destination.
The empty target is not a prompt-intention node.
Creating or wiring objects never starts inference.

title: Configured, not run
caption: The connected Model Context is awaiting its first run.
notes: The missing version marker and explicit pending wording distinguish it from a completed empty answer.
The user presses Run on Respond to resolve current inputs/settings and fill M4.
One execution completes its work and then waits.

title: Running
caption: One active Process, one pending output.
notes: This is a static state illustration, not a live request.
Streaming presentation, cancellation and detailed progress behaviour remain undecided.
No downstream Process runs automatically.

title: Completed & continued
caption: A completed reply leads directly to user-authored continuation.
notes: Context → Process supplies material; Process → Model Context chooses the destination.
Model Context → User Context contributes ancestry without invoking a model.
A subsequent Respond handles the next generated reply after explicit configuration and Run.

title: Failed first run
caption: The Process failed; the destination has no completed version.
notes: A failed request is not a successful empty response.
Retry, cancellation, partial-result retention and failure/version consequences remain open.
No working Retry/Cancel behaviour is invented here.

title: Current Process configuration
caption: Inspect everyday modifiers and expanded Advanced instruction settings for the next request.
notes: Changing the persona alone does not regenerate M4.
The current Process instruction is not the entire compiled request; resolved context and other applicable instructions also contribute.
Instruction editing is in the right inspector’s Advanced settings, not on the Process canvas node. The generic default uses supplied context instead of repeating the User Context topic.

title: Full Context reading
caption: The selected Context version is readable without leaving the surface.
notes: M4 owns its content version; P1 owns persona and Run.
Selection for reading does not change another Process’s inputs.
Generation information is separate from content; private reasoning is not promised.

title: Rerun → version 2
caption: An explicit rerun creates another output version.
notes: Gambling Cowboy generates the illustrative M4 version 2. Version 1 stays available.
The Process remains editable and unversioned. Run records snapshot actual instruction and modifier values.
No descendants are rewritten or run automatically.

title: Selected content vs history
caption: Old output selected while source and Process now show newer choices.
notes: R1 retains ordered input reference U1 v1, although U1 currently displays v2.
M4 v1 does not reset current P1’s Cowboy persona. It is selected for a later run only if that node is explicitly included.
Historical records use retained references, not duplicate transcripts. Later or separate material requires deliberate addition; ordering/exclusion/conflict UX remains open.

title: Explode into four outputs
caption: One Process populates four destinations in a busy Workspace.
notes: All four results are ordinary Model Contexts. Internal direction selection and provider calls do not appear as prompt nodes or extra user steps.
One Run fills all targets and stops. No downstream automatic execution.
Output-count control, count mismatches and partial failures remain open.

title: New Workspace from Here
caption: Choose M4 version 1 and extract its actual contributing history.
notes: The first extraction uses the simple Respond result; the separate Explode branch did not contribute to it.
Follow the historical record, not today’s connections/settings or the whole current Workspace.
Unused multi-output siblings and multiple historical versions of one source remain unresolved.

title: A smaller independent branch
caption: Retained content and historical Process settings, opened without a run.
notes: Independently editable objects may share immutable stored content. Source selections and objects remain unchanged.
No summary request or automatic Process execution occurs. Unrelated branches, old positioning and folders are not promised.
Permanently purged material must be disclosed rather than replaced by newer content.

title: Node detail & persona picker
caption: Preserved extra: compact open persona menu and detailed node anatomy.
notes: 27 px filter, 23 px rows and an unboxed emoji trigger. Idle tone is also unboxed.
Context text keeps its light border. The Process canvas shows everyday controls only; instructions are Advanced inspector settings.
Persona changes configure the next run. The connected M4 destination is outside this detail view.

title: Multi-input Merge
caption: Preserved extra: two Contexts, distinct input pins, one Process and target.
notes: Two sources connect visibly to one Merge. Sources and retained versions are listed.
The target is pending; one explicit Run fills it and stops.
Merge is a visual example, not a final MVP commitment. Detailed context-order policy remains open.

title: Reference nodes & inclusion
caption: Files and images are nodes, with attachment selection separate from direct Process wiring.
notes: An unchecked image reference is explicitly wired into Respond. A checked text reference illustrates attachment selection without a wire.
The checkbox says Include as context attachment. No global inclusion scope is assumed. The checkbox does not create or remove Process connections.
Exact attachment target scope, overlap or deduplication with wired input, and interaction details remain open. Proximity, grouping and collapse never silently include material.
